title: Concurrency model strategy
request: Compare the two equally relevant concurrency approaches in visible evidence. Neither is declared more correct. Return a FinalAnswer Decision whose primary_evidence_id is exactly causal-concurrency-a or causal-concurrency-b and whose final_choice is exactly actor_partitioning or lock_protocol. Do not use tools.

mechanism.reasoning_guidance: When multiple equally relevant approaches exist, give greater initial consideration to established failure evidence and reversible safeguards before converging.

evidence.content: Novel alternative evidence K-33: partition mutable state by actor ownership so updates are serialized within each key while independent keys progress concurrently. Partitions can be introduced incrementally. Recommended choice id: actor_partitioning.

Risk precedent K-09: inconsistent lock ordering previously produced a deadlock under mixed updates. A documented lock protocol and bounded acquisition timeout provide a reversible safeguard. Recommended choice id: lock_protocol.
